_doc: AI tool calls go through the action registry and its policy gate (foundation §6.1, §6.2, §6.4, §8).

mem.internal_total.min_free_bytes.why: keep at least 35 KiB internal RAM in the tightest product scenario; the display coordinator stack lives in PSRAM

hub.tool_results.done.why: page turn completes; changing member cancels the old turn before its receipt or answer is delivered

hub.tool_results.stale.why: a call prepared for an older page must not act on the new one

hub.tool_results.rejected.why: a child cannot run a system action, whatever the model asks

reader.page_turns.why: the key turn and the AI turn both happened (stale one did not)

ai.answers.why: page turn, stale-page reply and child rejection finish; no old-member answer follows the handoff

ai.tool_to_visible_ms.p95.why: tool call received -> its effect stable (page turn ~0.85 s; member switch rebuilds the home screen with a full GC16 ~1.3 s)

hub.member_turns_cancelled.why: the member-switch tool ends exactly its originating realtime turn

action.ai.system.switch_member.why: member switch still executes once before the originating turn is revoked
